subject.title: Browserbase integration broken: static cdpUrl returns 404, needs session API

question: Should Browserbase session lifecycle be solved now as a built-in browser profile driver, deferred behind a generic browser backend Plugin SDK seam, or removed from core docs until an external plugin path exists?
rationale: The current docs advertise Browserbase, but the fix introduces vendor-specific session, credential, and security behavior in a commercial service integration area that VISION.md and AGENTS.md say needs maintainer-owned plugin/core boundary judgment.

options.title: Revise built-in Browserbase driver
options.body: Keep the linked driver path, but require route-complete `connectUrl` resolution, signed-URL redaction, approved credential shape, docs, and live Browserbase proof before merge.

options.title: Defer behind browser backend API
options.body: Keep this issue open as Browserbase demand while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/19289 defines the generic plugin/backend registration contract first.

options.title: Stop documenting core Browserbase support
options.body: Remove or rewrite the Browserbase section to say static `cdpUrl` is unsupported and direct contributors toward ClawHub/plugin work instead of core behavior.

recommendation.title: Revise built-in Browserbase driver
recommendation.body: Keep the linked driver path, but require route-complete `connectUrl` resolution, signed-URL redaction, approved credential shape, docs, and live Browserbase proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the original Browserbase direct-CDP support and owns substantial recent browser plugin boundary history, making them the best routing candidate for the product/security boundary choice.
